jobs.description:
Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

Overview

Join an iconic brand that is redefining the pickup truck and rugged SUV marketplace.

As the Senior Manager of Software Engineering for Order Management Platform, you will lead the engineering team responsible for Scout's system of record for customer vehicle orders and the orchestration platform that manages order state transitions throughout the vehicle purchasing and delivery journey.

You will be responsible for the engineering strategy, execution, reliability, scalability, and operational excellence of the Order Management Platform while building and developing a high-performing team of software engineers. Working closely with Product Management, Finance, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Retail Operations, Customer Experience, and Enterprise Systems teams, you will deliver critical capabilities that power Scout's direct-to-consumer business model and support a world-class customer purchasing experience.

This role combines people leadership, technical ownership, strategic planning, and delivery accountability for one of the most business-critical domains within Scout's digital ecosystem. The role aligns with Scout's engineering leadership structure, bridging team-level execution and broader domain ownership.

What you’ll do

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

Team Leadership

Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of software engineers responsible for the Order Management platform.
Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
Drive hiring, onboarding, career development, performance management, and succession planning activities.
Mentor senior engineers and help develop future technical and organizational leaders.
Partner with Staff Engineers to raise the overall technical maturity and effectiveness of the team.

Domain Ownership

Own engineering execution and operational excellence for Scout's Order Management Platform.
Drive the evolution of the platform responsible for managing order lifecycle events and order state transitions from reservation through vehicle delivery.
Ensure seamless integration between Order Management Platform and key business systems including CRM, Payment, Finance, ERP, Manufacturing, Inventory, Logistics, Delivery, and Customer Experience platforms.
Balance delivery of business capabilities with long-term investments in platform scalability, reliability, maintainability, and operational efficiency.
Lead engineering efforts supporting:
Order creation and management
Vehicle configuration and change management
Pricing and incentives
Financing and leasing integrations
Vehicle allocation
Production readiness
Fulfillment and delivery preparation
Customer order status and communications

Technical Leadership

Partner closely with Staff Engineers and architects to define the technical direction and long-term roadmap of the Order Management Platform.
Drive engineering best practices across architecture, code quality, testing, CI/CD, observability, security, and operational readiness.
Participate in architecture reviews and key technical decision-making processes.
Ensure systems are designed for scalability, resiliency, performance, and maintainability.
Influence platform modernization initiatives and technical investment decisions.
Drive the application of AI and intelligent automation capabilities within the Order Management domain to reduce manual processes, improve order accuracy, accelerate issue resolution, and enhance customer and employee experiences.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies and partner with Product, Architecture, and Data teams to incorporate high-value AI capabilities into Order Management Platform workflows, operational processes, customer communications, and platform strategy.

Product Delivery & Execution

Partner with Product Management to translate business objectives into technical solutions and execution plans.
Drive predictable delivery of roadmap commitments through effective planning, risk management, dependency coordination, and execution oversight.
Align engineering priorities with business goals while balancing short-term delivery and long-term platform sustainability.
Communicate progress, risks, tradeoffs, and technical recommendations to leadership and stakeholders.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with Product, Finance, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Retail Operations, Customer Experience, and IT teams.
Lead cross-functional initiatives spanning multiple business domains and enterprise systems.
Build strong partnerships with vendors, enterprise teams, and external technology partners where required.
Help drive alignment across teams to deliver end-to-end customer and business outcomes.

Operational Excellence

Establish and track operational metrics for system availability, reliability, performance, and service health.
Own production readiness, incident management, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement processes.
Ensure engineering teams maintain operational ownership and accountability for production systems.
Drive automation, monitoring, alerting, and observability best practices.
Establish service-level objectives and reliability standards for critical order processing workflows.

Location & Travel Expectations
:

This role will be based out of the Scout Motors location in Fremont, California.
This role requires regular attendance in the office, with regular in-person meetings and events.
Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time.

What you’ll bring

We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You’ll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You’ll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical discipline.
10+ years of software engineering experience.
3+ years of engineering management experience leading software engineering teams.
Proven experience leading software engineering teams delivering customer-facing or business-critical platforms.
Strong understanding of distributed systems, APIs, cloud-native architectures, event-driven systems, and modern software engineering practices.
Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives across multiple stakeholders and business functions.
Excellent communication, collaboration, and organizational leadership skills.
Demonstrated ability to build, develop, and retain high-performing engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting direct-to-consumer digital commerce experiences.
Experience integrating with enterprise systems, financial platforms, and third-party technology providers.
Familiarity with AI-powered applications, intelligent automation, and data-driven operational platforms.
Experience with AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, event-driven architectures, and modern DevOps practices.
Automotive, retail, e-commerce, or fintech industry experience.

What you'll gain

The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up. This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation. About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.
The Opportunity
🚀

Carrot is seeking a Sr. Manager, Data Engineering to lead our Business Intelligence data engineering function as it scales to meet, and anticipate, the needs of the organization and its clients. This is a senior player/coach role with a strong emphasis on strategic leadership, technical excellence, and organizational impact. You will lead and grow a high-impact team while remaining deeply hands-on in architecting and building Carrot's data infrastructure.
You will set technical vision, drive cross-functional data strategy, and ensure our data systems are reliable, scalable, secure, and aligned with business priorities. You will influence and execute on the long-term roadmap for Data Engineering within the Data Team, defining how we ingest, transform, govern, and expose data across the company, and partner closely with senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Operations, Analytics, and Go-To-Market functions.
Given the small-but-mighty nature of the team, this role requires someone who is comfortable operating at multiple altitudes: setting multi-year architectural direction, shaping team and org design, and still rolling up their sleeves to build production-grade pipelines when needed.

What You’ll Own
💼

In this role, you will:
Own the technical vision and roadmap
for BI data engineering, aligning it with company strategy and analytics needs.
Design, build, and review scalable ETL/ELT pipelines
and workflow orchestration systems, contributing hands-on production code in Python and SQL
.
Architect and optimize data warehouse models
that support advanced analytics, self-service BI, and operational reporting.
Establish and enforce standards for reliability, observability, testing, and performance
across all data systems.
Drive improvements in data quality, lineage, and governance
, including documentation and metadata practices.
Partner with backend product engineering teams to co-design production database schemas
and event models with analytics and reporting in mind.
Lead, mentor, and develop a team of data engineers
, fostering a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and collaboration.
Own team-level planning and execution
, including capacity planning, prioritization, and delivery across concurrent workstreams.
Translate ambiguous business and analytics needs into a clear, prioritized engineering roadmap
with measurable outcomes.
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Security, and Legal
to align on priorities, ensure compliance, and remove cross-functional blockers.
Evaluate and influence build vs. buy decisions
, vendor selection, and tool adoption across data platforms, ingestion, and transformation.

What Success Looks Like
 📈

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:
Elevated the maturity and consistency
of data engineering practices across the BI function, with clear standards for reliability, testing, and observability.
Built and retained a high-performing data engineering team
recognized as a trusted partner to stakeholders across the business.
Delivered a prioritized data engineering roadmap
aligned with company strategy, with measurable progress on scalability and platform modernization.
Strengthened the accuracy, recency, and security
of enterprise data, meeting the requirements of regulated healthcare contexts.
Enabled advanced analytics, self-service BI, and data products
that drive meaningful business outcomes and influence Carrot's long-term data architecture strategy.

About You
✨

You likely have:
8-10+ years

of experience in data engineering or a closely related field, including 3-5+ years
leading and managing data or software engineers.
5+ years of advanced SQL

and 5+ years of Python development
experience in production environments, including unit and integration testing.
Strong, hands-on experience designing, building, and maintaining end-to-end ETL/ELT pipelines
in production.
Proficiency with cloud-based data platforms
(e.g., Snowflake, AWS) and modern ingestion, transformation, and orchestration tools (e.g., Fivetran, dbt, Prefect, Airflow).
Strong understanding of relational modeling and warehouse design principles
, plus version control (Git preferred) and modern CI/CD practices.
Demonstrated ability to define technical strategy and standards
while remaining capable of direct technical execution.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
, with strong knowledge of data governance, security best practices, and compliance protocols.

Nice to Have
⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:
Direct experience with Carrot's current tech stack
: Snowflake, Fivetran, dbt, Prefect, and AWS.
Experience with enterprise BI platforms
and enabling self-service analytics.
Experience integrating batch and event-streaming or real-time ingestion systems
.
Prior experience leading data engineering teams in a startup or high-growth environment
, ideally including managing other leads or senior-level ICs.
Healthcare industry experience

, including familiarity with healthcare data standards (HL7, FHIR) and privacy regulations (HIPAA, GDPR).

Why This Role Matters
🧡

The reliability, scalability, and usability of Carrot's data systems directly power decision-making across the organization and for our clients. Data Engineering plays a foundational role in enabling the broader Business Intelligence function, and this role serves as the senior-most manager directly responsible for that capability.

Impact

jobs.description:
Introduction

At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the world’s leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn, grow, and make an impact on a global scale. Working in Software means joining a team fueled by curiosity and collaboration. You’ll work with diverse technologies, partners, and industries to design, develop, and deliver solutions that power digital transformation. With a culture that values innovation, growth, and continuous learning, IBM Software places you at the heart of IBM’s product and technology landscape. Here, you’ll have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world. With Confluent, data doesn’t sit still. We put information in motion, streaming in near real time so organizations can react faster, build smarter, and deliver experiences as dynamic as the world around them.

Your Role And Responsibilities

About the Role:

We're seeking a hands-on Senior Engineering Manager to join our Experience Foundations team. This team owns critical TEAR (Trusted Experiences Access & Revenue) domains including Security UI, Networking UI, and Billing UI, as well as the shared experience foundations infrastructure (formerly UIF/UI Foundations team).

You'll lead the evolution of our foundations infrastructure from UI-only support to serving the entire Experience organization which includes several other interfaces (API/CLI/TF/VSCode/MCP). Along with this you will help establish patterns and best practices that enable UI engineers to confidently develop security and networking features across our application portfolio—including Governance, Flink, Kafka, Connect, and Tableflow.

In this role, you'll also support the evolution of Networking, Security, and Billing UI experiences, especially as we adopt and integrate the latest and greatest technologies in these domains. As cloud providers introduce new networking capabilities, security standards evolve, and billing models become more sophisticated, you'll ensure our UI stays at the forefront—providing intuitive, scalable interfaces that make complex technical capabilities accessible to our customers.

The Experience Foundations Team Owns Several Critical Pillars

Security: User authentication, authorization, and security experiences (RBAC, BYOK, SSO, API keys, encryption management)
Networking: Network configuration and connectivity interfaces (private networking, VPC peering, PrivateLink across AWS, GCP, Azure)
Billing UI: Revenue-critical billing and payment experiences (subscription models, multi-month commits, promotional offers, chargebacks, usage tracking
Experience Foundations Infrastructure: Shared UI/UX infrastructure and tooling (formerly UIF/UI Foundations), this includes our design system, compliance support, experience performance, accessibility and more.

These capabilities sit at the intersection of trust, infrastructure control, and revenue generation—foundational pillars that support our entire application ecosystem across Governance, Flink, Kafka, Connect, Tableflow, and future products.

What You Will Do:
Technical Leadership & Engineering Excellence

Establish clear, reusable patterns and best practices for UI engineers developing security and networking code
Elevate the impact of all UI engineers across multiple product teams (Governance, Flink, Kafka, Connect, Tableflow)
Take a depth-first, hands-on approach to understanding systems and unblocking teams
Go deep in domain areas—understand the technical intricacies of networking protocols, security models, and billing systems to make sound architectural decisions
Drive the evolution of Experience Foundations infrastructure from UI-only to supporting the entire Experience organization, partner with the existing Engineering Manager to shape and execute the foundations roadmap

Cross-Functional Partnership

Own PM and Design partnerships for Security, Networking, and Billing domains
Ensure smooth execution and delivery of product initiatives across these verticals
Bridge technical and product perspectives to drive aligned outcomes
Translate domain complexity into clear execution plans
Challenge product specs when necessary to ensure technical feasibility
Partner with product teams across the portfolio to ensure patterns meet their needs
Communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs transparently to senior leadership

Team & People Management

Collaborate with existing engineering leadership to build cohesive team strategy, including existing manager in the foundations space as your direct report
Mentor and develop engineers across multiple disciplines and experience levels
Foster a culture of ownership, excellence, and continuous improvement
Create leverage by empowering engineers with patterns, tools, and knowledge
Build strong connections between Experience Foundations and application teams
Champion developer productivity through AI tooling adoption, test automation, and improved engineering processes

Your work will enable UX engineers across our entire application portfolio to build consistent, high-quality security and networking experiences. By establishing clear patterns and evolving our foundations infrastructure, you'll multiply the impact of every engineer working on Governance, Flink, Kafka, Connect, Tableflow, and future products—while supporting the foundational pillars that drive over 70% of Confluent's revenue.

If you're energized by the challenge of transforming foundations infrastructure while elevating engineering capabilities across critical product domains, we'd love to talk.

Preferred Education

None

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

5+ years of experience leading software engineering teams
Strong hands-on technical background with ability to dive deep into complex systems
Deep frontend engineering expertise: Strong understanding of modern web development (React, TypeScript, component design systems)
Proven ability to distill complex technical domains into clear patterns and best practices
Experience creating reusable patterns/frameworks adopted across multiple teams or products
Track record of elevating team capabilities through mentorship and knowledge sharing
Demonstrated success partnering with Product and Design to drive execution
Experience managing or collaborating closely with other engineering managers
Experience managing multiple product areas or technical domains simultaneously

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

Experience managing managers or leading leaders
Domain knowledge in at least one TEAR area: Security (RBAC, SSO, BYOK, encryption), Networking (VPC, PrivateLink, routing), or Billing/Payments (subscription models, usage tracking)
Experience evolving platform teams to serve broader organizational needs
Proficient with or highly curious about AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, etc.)
Track record of driving developer productivity improvements through tooling, automation, or process innovation

Chief Technology Officer (CTO)

An early-stage software company building tools for technical teams working with AI and robotics systems, helping them manage complex data and workflows to build more reliable automated systems. Moving from early prototypes and customer proof points into a production-grade platform, they need a CTO to build the engineering organisation and product to get them there.

About the Role

A hands-on leadership role owning technical strategy, architecture, engineering execution, and hiring across product engineering, infrastructure, and applied AI.
This is a builder's role first and a manager's role second. You'll set the technical direction, shape the architecture, grow the engineering team, and stay hands-on enough to catch problems before they become expensive.
Expect to move between big-picture decisions and the occasional deep dive into the codebase, and to work closely with founders, customers, and the research side of the business. It's not a job for someone who wants to run engineering from a distance, you need to genuinely understand what's being built and why.

Shape the platform's architecture and turn early-stage prototypes into dependable, production-ready systems
Grow and lead the engineering function, covering everything from core infrastructure to applied research integration
Set the standards the team works to — quality, testing, security, uptime
Decide what to build versus what to buy, and turn customer and research input into a coherent roadmap
Take ownership of data handling, security, and the operational maturity needed to serve larger customers
Act as the technical face of the company for customers, partners, and investors

What They Need

A track record of building and scaling real-world software systems, not just prototypes
Broad technical range — backend engineering, cloud infrastructure, data systems, and modern AI/ML
Experience running engineering teams somewhere early-stage and fast-moving
Sound judgement on tradeoffs — architecture, technical debt, hiring, sequencing
The ability to bridge research thinking and production discipline without mixing the two up
Someone with genuine ownership, minimal ego, and solid follow-through

Bonus Points

Exposure to intelligent systems, automation, or data-heavy technical products
Experience serving enterprise or highly regulated customers
Background untangling messy, large-scale, or multimodal data pipelines
Having actually taken something from first customer to repeatable, scalable delivery

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer Manager - Ecosystems & Integration
jobs.description:
Who Are We?

Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster.

The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman.

P.S: We highly recommend reading The "API-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman.

The Opportunity

Postman is seeking a strategic and results-driven engineering leader who is passionate about APIs, partnerships, ecosystems, collaboration, and developer success.

As the Sr. Engineering Manager for Ecosystems & Integration, you’ll build and lead a talented group of engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and excellence while guiding the team to build scalable, reliable, high-performance features that power the future of our Ecosystem. You’ll work closely with other engineering managers, product managers, and designers to drive the vision and execution of the product roadmap that will empower developers + partners to create rich, integrated experiences that will help teams create, collaborate, manage, and scale their APIs and solutions. This position requires a strategic thinker with a deep understanding of developer ecosystems and a passion for delivering exceptional developer experiences. You will define our technical strategy to achieve our ecosystem goals, including how extensibility, integration frameworks and public APIs work at Postman, how integrations look, feel, and behave to our end users, and how customers discover, install, and buy apps via a marketplace.

If you’re passionate about building products that make an impact, have a proven track record of leading engineering teams to success, and thrive in dynamic, fast-paced environments, we want you on our team!

What You’ll Do

Team Leadership & Development

Hire, manage, mentor, and coach several teams of engineers, helping them grow both technically and professionally.
Drive and uphold a culture of respect, integrity, inclusion, ownership, and accountability within the team.
Set clear goals and provide regular feedback to ensure your team is motivated and aligned with the product and company vision.
Design strategies for developer success across many areas, including those that are still in the early stages of finding their product-market fit.
Experiment, design, and influence rigorously the creation of new kinds of experiences for consumers and the new business models that will support builders, creators, partners, and developers.

Technical Leadership

Facilitate and coordinate the technical design and execution of complex features for Postman’s ecosystem platform ensuring scalability, performance, and reliability for millions of customers and partners everywhere.
Partner with leaders at strategic companies in the ecosystem to define high value product offerings through Postman app as well as the partner app and marketplaces.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and other engineering managers, to deliver high-quality, customer-focused features.
Ensure engineering best practices are upheld, including code reviews, testing, and continuous delivery.

Project Management

Own the engineering roadmap for Ecosystem, including Developer Tooling, Strategic Integrations and Marketplace, balancing short-term delivery with long-term technical and business investments.
Break down complex initiatives into clear, actionable milestones and manage the delivery of these projects on time.
Proactively identify and resolve roadblocks, ensuring your team meets its deadlines and delivers features with high quality.

Collaboration & Communication

Work closely with stakeholders across engineering, product, and design teams to ensure alignment on priorities and deliverables.
Foster open communication within the team, promoting collaboration and transparency.
Represent the engineering team in meetings with leadership, advocating for technical needs and constraints while aligning with broader company goals.

Operational Excellence

Ensure the reliability and performance of Ecosystem products by driving operational best practices for monitoring, logging, and incident response.
Optimize the team’s workflow by implementing automation and improving processes where needed.
Maintain a high level of code quality and system robustness by promoting test-driven development and continuous integration.

About You

You are a seasoned engineering leader with a passion for building great products, fostering strong teams, and solving challenging technical problems. You have a track record of managing high-performing engineering teams and driving technical projects from concept to delivery geared towards helping 3rd party developers build impactful apps quickly and successfully (ex. Shopify, Atlassian, HubSpot, Slack, etc.)

Must Have Qualifications

10+ years of experience as a software engineer, with 5+ years in an engineering management or leadership role.
Experience building and launching 0 → 1 ecosystem features, platform extensibility (UI components, frameworks, APIs), developer tooling and/or products for external technical audiences.
Proven experience leading teams in fast-paced, agile environments.
Strong background in backend or frontend development (experience with React, Java a plus).
Demonstrated ability to coach and mentor engineers, helping them grow and succeed.
Experience managing the full software development lifecycle, from design through production support.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

Nice-to-Have

Familiarity with API development, cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), and container orchestration (Kubernetes).
Prior experience working in a SaaS or cloud-based environment.
A passion for building systems that prioritize scalability, performance, and operational excellence.

The reasonably estimated base salary for this role ranges from $260,000 to $300,000, plus a competitive equity package. Actual compensation is based on the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience.

What Else?

In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about. We’re building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves.

At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in-person that cannot be replicated via zoom.

Our Values

At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can.

Equal opportunity

jobs.title: Sr Director, Technology Partner Alliances Development
jobs.description:
Black Duck Software, Inc. helps organizations build secure, high-quality software, minimizing risks while maximizing speed and productivity. Black Duck, a recognized pioneer in application security, provides SAST, SCA, and DAST solutions that enable teams to quickly find and fix vulnerabilities and defects in proprietary code, open source components, and application behavior. With a combination of industry-leading tools, services, and expertise, only Black Duck helps organizations maximize security and quality in DevSecOps and throughout the software development life cycle.

Sr. Director, Strategic

Technology Alliances

THE OPPORTUNITY

At Black Duck Software, we are redefining how organizations secure software across the modern development lifecycle. As a leader in application security testing, software composition analysis, software supply chain security, and application security posture management, we help organizations build trust into every stage of software development.

We are seeking a Senior Director of Strategic Technology Alliances to establish and scale Black Duck’s technology partnership ecosystem. This highly visible leadership role will define alliance strategy, build transformative technology relationships, and create integration-led growth opportunities that accelerate innovation, customer value, and revenue.

This is a unique opportunity to build a world-class technology alliance function from the ground up while partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Legal, and Executive Leadership to shape Black Duck’s ecosystem strategy and market influence.

What You’ll Do

Build and Lead Black Duck’s Technology Alliance Strategy

Establish and execute the long-term vision, operating model, and growth strategy for Black Duck’s technology alliance ecosystem.
Develop a strategic framework for evaluating build, buy, and partner opportunities that strengthens Black Duck’s market position and product differentiation.
Create and manage a portfolio of strategic technology alliances and product partnerships across AI, DevSecOps, developer tools, cloud platforms, software supply chain intelligence, and ASPM ecosystems.
Conduct ongoing competitive and ecosystem analysis to identify emerging partnership opportunities and market trends.

Drive High-Impact Strategic Partnerships

Own the full partnership lifecycle, from identification and qualification through negotiation, launch, adoption, and scale.
Build executive-level relationships with leading technology providers, cloud platforms, AI innovators, and developer ecosystems.
Lead complex commercial negotiations involving revenue sharing, IP rights, go-to-market commitments, licensing structures, exclusivity arrangements, and strategic investments.
Partner with Legal, Product, and Executive Leadership to structure agreements that maximize business value and market impact.

Accelerate Integration-Led Growth

Champion partnerships that drive meaningful product integrations, customer adoption, revenue growth, and competitive advantage.
Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to prioritize and operationalize strategic integrations.
Define and track metrics including integration adoption, partner-sourced pipeline, influenced revenue, customer engagement, and ecosystem growth.
Develop scalable playbooks that move partnerships from Discovery to Pilot to Commercialization to Scale.

Build a World-Class Alliance Function

Create governance processes, scorecards, stage-gate frameworks, executive steering committees, QBRs, and KPI dashboards.
Establish disciplined operating rhythms that enable transparency, accountability, and measurable business outcomes.
Influence and align cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority across Sales, Product, Marketing, Engineering, Finance, and Legal.
Serve as Black Duck’s primary executive leader for technology alliance strategy and ecosystem expansion.

What Success Looks Like

Within Your First Year, You Will

Establish Black Duck’s technology alliance operating model and governance framework.
Build a prioritized portfolio of strategic technology partnerships.
Launch high-value integrations that enhance customer value and platform differentiation.
Create measurable partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline growth.
Deliver alliance-driven revenue contribution against agreed business objectives.
Position Black Duck as a preferred partner within the broader AppSec, DevSecOps, AI, and cloud ecosystems.

Qualifications

Required

Prior experience building a Strategic Alliances Program and Team for an Enterprise Software Company, preferably in Application Security
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
10+ years of technology partnerships, strategic alliances, business development, or ecosystem leadership experience within SaaS or enterprise software.
Demonstrated success building and scaling partnership functions from concept to execution.
Experience leading and negotiating complex strategic agreements with deal values exceeding $5M.
Proven track record driving partnership-attributed revenue, co-sell motions, and strategic market expansion.
Experience structuring revenue-sharing models, licensing agreements, IP frameworks, and commercial partnership terms.
Strong executive presence with the ability to influence senior stakeholders internally and externally.
Exceptional communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
Ability to lead highly complex initiatives through influence, alignment, and operational rigor.

Preferred

Experience within application security, DevSecOps, software supply chain security, cloud security, developer platforms, AI tooling, or enterprise software.
Direct experience partnering with AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Anthropic, OpenAI, GitHub, GitLab, Atlassian, or other leading technology ecosystems.
An established network across the cloud, developer tooling, AI, or cybersecurity partner landscape.
Experience engaging executive buyers and technology leaders, including CIOs, CISOs, CTOs, and Heads of Engineering.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Product Management- Global Payment Network
jobs.description:
Sr Director, Product Management (PXDP65)

Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology. We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.

About The Team

As part of the Global Payments Network Product team, you will help lead and own the core authorization domain that sits at the center of every transaction we process: authorization decisioning, rules and configuration, routing, resiliency, and trust (fraud/risk signaling, credential validation, tokenization). This leader will be accountable end-to-end for the platform's ability to authorize transactions correctly, securely, and reliably at scale across all networks (DN, DCI, PULSE) and schemes, setting the highest bar for change control, testing, and uptime given that any defect in this domain directly threatens live money movement — while drawing a clear, defensible boundary between what belongs in the core versus what should live in adjacent domains (boarding, client servicing, settlement, regulatory/risk, data & insights, etc.). The ideal candidate has deep experience running mission-critical, high-availability transaction-processing systems in payments or financial services, a track record of building platforms designed for products not yet imagined rather than re-architecting around today's requirements, and the organizational maturity to partner closely with peer domain owners, product, and risk/compliance stakeholders during a major platform migration and cutover.

Capital One Product Framework

In this role, you’ll be expected to demonstrate proficiency in five key areas which we consider to be the foundation for successful Product management:

Human Centered - Obsesses about internal and external customer needs to reimagine and innovate product solutions
Business Focused - Delivers game-changing outcomes by focusing on leverage and execution excellence
Technology Driven - Leverages technology to deliver innovative and resilient solutions that enable both near term and long term value
Integrated Problem Solving - Identifies and resolves complex problems to deliver outcomes while mitigating product risks
Transformational Leadership - Leads cross functional teams to solve customer problems and drive organizational alignment

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in any field and at least 7 years of Product Management experience

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience translating business strategy and analysis into consumer facing digital products

Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location, and the actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter.

This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan.

Capital One offers a comprehensive, competitive, and inclusive set of health, financial and other benefits that support your total well-being. Learn more at the Capital One Careers website. Eligibility varies based on full or part-time status, exempt or non-exempt status, and management level.

No agencies please. Capital One is an equal opportunity employer (EOE, including disability/vet) committed to non-discrimination in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Experience Foundations - Confluent
jobs.description:
Introduction

At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the world’s leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn, grow, and make an impact on a global scale. Working in Software means joining a team fueled by curiosity and collaboration. You’ll work with diverse technologies, partners, and industries to design, develop, and deliver solutions that power digital transformation. With a culture that values innovation, growth, and continuous learning, IBM Software places you at the heart of IBM’s product and technology landscape. Here, you’ll have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world. With Confluent, data doesn’t sit still. We put information in motion, streaming in near real time so organizations can react faster, build smarter, and deliver experiences as dynamic as the world around them.

Your Role And Responsibilities

About the Role:

We're seeking a hands-on Senior Engineering Manager to join our Experience Foundations team. This team owns critical TEAR (Trusted Experiences Access & Revenue) domains including Security UI, Networking UI, and Billing UI, as well as the shared experience foundations infrastructure (formerly UIF/UI Foundations team).

You'll lead the evolution of our foundations infrastructure from UI-only support to serving the entire Experience organization which includes several other interfaces (API/CLI/TF/VSCode/MCP). Along with this you will help establish patterns and best practices that enable UI engineers to confidently develop security and networking features across our application portfolio—including Governance, Flink, Kafka, Connect, and Tableflow.

In this role, you'll also support the evolution of Networking, Security, and Billing UI experiences, especially as we adopt and integrate the latest and greatest technologies in these domains. As cloud providers introduce new networking capabilities, security standards evolve, and billing models become more sophisticated, you'll ensure our UI stays at the forefront—providing intuitive, scalable interfaces that make complex technical capabilities accessible to our customers.

The Experience Foundations Team Owns Several Critical Pillars

Security: User authentication, authorization, and security experiences (RBAC, BYOK, SSO, API keys, encryption management)
Networking: Network configuration and connectivity interfaces (private networking, VPC peering, PrivateLink across AWS, GCP, Azure)
Billing UI: Revenue-critical billing and payment experiences (subscription models, multi-month commits, promotional offers, chargebacks, usage tracking
Experience Foundations Infrastructure: Shared UI/UX infrastructure and tooling (formerly UIF/UI Foundations), this includes our design system, compliance support, experience performance, accessibility and more.

These capabilities sit at the intersection of trust, infrastructure control, and revenue generation—foundational pillars that support our entire application ecosystem across Governance, Flink, Kafka, Connect, Tableflow, and future products.

What You Will Do:
Technical Leadership & Engineering Excellence

Establish clear, reusable patterns and best practices for UI engineers developing security and networking code
Elevate the impact of all UI engineers across multiple product teams (Governance, Flink, Kafka, Connect, Tableflow)
Take a depth-first, hands-on approach to understanding systems and unblocking teams
Go deep in domain areas—understand the technical intricacies of networking protocols, security models, and billing systems to make sound architectural decisions
Drive the evolution of Experience Foundations infrastructure from UI-only to supporting the entire Experience organization, partner with the existing Engineering Manager to shape and execute the foundations roadmap

Cross-Functional Partnership

Own PM and Design partnerships for Security, Networking, and Billing domains
Ensure smooth execution and delivery of product initiatives across these verticals
Bridge technical and product perspectives to drive aligned outcomes
Translate domain complexity into clear execution plans
Challenge product specs when necessary to ensure technical feasibility
Partner with product teams across the portfolio to ensure patterns meet their needs
Communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs transparently to senior leadership

Team & People Management

Collaborate with existing engineering leadership to build cohesive team strategy, including existing manager in the foundations space as your direct report
Mentor and develop engineers across multiple disciplines and experience levels
Foster a culture of ownership, excellence, and continuous improvement
Create leverage by empowering engineers with patterns, tools, and knowledge
Build strong connections between Experience Foundations and application teams
Champion developer productivity through AI tooling adoption, test automation, and improved engineering processes

Your work will enable UX engineers across our entire application portfolio to build consistent, high-quality security and networking experiences. By establishing clear patterns and evolving our foundations infrastructure, you'll multiply the impact of every engineer working on Governance, Flink, Kafka, Connect, Tableflow, and future products—while supporting the foundational pillars that drive over 70% of Confluent's revenue.

If you're energized by the challenge of transforming foundations infrastructure while elevating engineering capabilities across critical product domains, we'd love to talk.

Preferred Education

None

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

5+ years of experience leading software engineering teams
Strong hands-on technical background with ability to dive deep into complex systems
Deep frontend engineering expertise: Strong understanding of modern web development (React, TypeScript, component design systems)
Proven ability to distill complex technical domains into clear patterns and best practices
Experience creating reusable patterns/frameworks adopted across multiple teams or products
Track record of elevating team capabilities through mentorship and knowledge sharing
Demonstrated success partnering with Product and Design to drive execution
Experience managing or collaborating closely with other engineering managers
Experience managing multiple product areas or technical domains simultaneously

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

Experience managing managers or leading leaders
Domain knowledge in at least one TEAR area: Security (RBAC, SSO, BYOK, encryption), Networking (VPC, PrivateLink, routing), or Billing/Payments (subscription models, usage tracking)
Experience evolving platform teams to serve broader organizational needs
Proficient with or highly curious about AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, etc.)
Track record of driving developer productivity improvements through tooling, automation, or process innovation

This platform will support expansion into new content domains including VAT Advanced Sections, Registration, Business Licenses, XBorder Marketplace, and Communications, while also improving the efficiency and scalability of existing content operations through automation and AI-assisted workflows.

This role combines platform engineering, applied AI, workflow automation, and organizational leadership. Success in this role requires balancing technical innovation with operational rigor, measurable business outcomes, platform reliability, and responsible AI adoption.

The platform is expected to improve content scalability, accelerate onboarding of new content domains, reduce manual research effort, and enable content teams to operate through AI-assisted and human-reviewed workflows.

What Your Responsibilities Will Be

Define and execute the engineering vision, architecture, and delivery roadmap for the Agentic Content Studio Platform.
Build scalable platform capabilities that support onboarding and maintenance of global compliance content across multiple domains.
Lead development of AI-assisted workflows that automate sourcing, extraction, transformation, validation, and maintenance of content.
Establish reliable human-in-the-loop operating models that combine AI-driven automation with researcher review and oversight.
Design secure, observable, and resilient platform services spanning orchestration, APIs, workflow automation, integrations, and content systems.
Enable downstream products and services such as AvaTax, ATC, and ATR to interact with platform capabilities through modern integration interfaces, including MCP where appropriate.
Define measurable engineering and operational metrics tied to platform reliability, quality, productivity, adoption, and business impact.
Partner closely with Product, Content Research, Applied AI, Architecture, and business stakeholders to align platform investments with company priorities.
Build and develop a high-performing engineering organization with strong technical depth, accountability, and execution discipline.
Drive pragmatic adoption of AI across engineering workflows, planning, delivery operations, observability, and decision-making processes.
Ensure governance, security, and responsible AI practices are incorporated into platform design and operational processes.

12-Month Success Outcomes

Deliver and operationalize a clear ACSP platform roadmap aligned to Avalara’s content expansion and productivity objectives.
Launch foundational platform capabilities supporting the first wave of new content domains and workflow automation initiatives.
Deliver production-ready AI-assisted workflows for sourcing and extracting international lodging content in targeted countries.
Deliver scalable workflows supporting generation and maintenance of VAT advanced section content across multiple countries.
Improve operational efficiency by reducing manual content research and maintenance effort through automation and reviewer-assisted workflows.
Establish reliable production integrations enabling downstream systems to consume platform capabilities through standardized interfaces.
Implement measurable operational metrics for reliability, automation coverage, quality, cycle time, and platform adoption.
Build a strong engineering leadership team with clear ownership, high accountability, and strong execution standards.

Applied AI Expectations

Apply AI to improve automation, scalability, quality, and operational efficiency.
Design agent-based workflows capable of coordinating multi-step content tasks with appropriate escalation and human review mechanisms.
Leverage AI to improve engineering execution, planning, observability, and operational workflows.
Drive adoption of AI capabilities as part of core platform functionality and engineering operations rather than isolated experimentation.
Ensure responsible use of AI through governance, transparency, monitoring, and risk controls.
Raise engineering team capability through coaching, standards, and practical implementation guidance.

What You’ll Need To Be Successful

12+ years of software engineering experience, including large-scale platforms or distributed systems.
5+ years of experience leading engineering managers and senior engineers in complex cross-functional organizations.
Proven experience leading platform strategy, architecture, and execution with measurable business outcomes.
Experience applying AI and automation to improve operational scale, quality, productivity, or customer impact.
Strong experience with distributed systems, APIs, workflow orchestration, integrations, and event-driven architectures.
Experience building platforms that support automation, operational observability, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
Strong cross-functional leadership skills with the ability to align engineering investments to business priorities.
Excellent execution rigor, technical judgment, communication skills, and organizational leadership.

Technical Expertise

Experience with LLMs, agent-based systems, RAG architectures, or equivalent AI platforms.
Strong engineering background in Python and modern AI application frameworks.
Experience building cloud-native systems on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Familiarity with MLOps practices including CI/CD, evaluation pipelines, monitoring, and model lifecycle management.
Strong platform and systems design experience focused on reliability, scalability, and operational excellence.

Leadership Characteristics

Demonstrated ability to build and mentor high-performing engineering organizations.
Strong product and platform mindset with a focus on customer and business outcomes.
Ability to communicate effectively with senior technical and executive stakeholders.
Pragmatic, execution-oriented leader capable of operating strategically while remaining technically engaged.

AI Bar Raiser

At Avalara, this role is expected to be an AI Bar Raiser — a leader who elevates both the technical capability of the organization and the practical application of AI across engineering and operational workflows.

This individual is expected to apply advanced AI capabilities to materially improve how systems are designed, built, operated, and scaled, while driving measurable gains in engineering productivity, quality, automation, and business impact. The expectation is to create a culture of 10x productivity through the effective use of AI tools, modern engineering technologies, automation, and an agile execution mindset where speed is table stakes.

Bar Raiser

The company plans to develop future habitats and systems for the Moon and Mars, dedicated space stations for government partners, and other crewed systems that will unlock the expanding long-term space economy.

Vast is seeking a Director, Mission Engineering & Management
to own program and mission execution for a new constellation-ready spacecraft bus product line. Our first mission is a 10-satellite demo launch — the plan is to scale to hundreds of spacecraft per year.

We're developing a new constellation-ready 15kW spacecraft bus, with our first mission being a 10-satellite demo launch in Q4 2027 — multiple customer payloads, and a product line designed to scale to hundreds of spacecraft per year. This role owns the program and mission execution side: schedule, requirements, budgets, customer relationships, and launch campaign planning. You're the counterpart to the Director of Engineering — they deliver the hardware, you deliver the mission.

Between the two of you, systems engineering is covered. You own system-level requirements and interfaces, and you own whether engineering's bottoms-up budgets close against what the mission demands. You're the internal voice of the customer — pressure-testing engineering decisions against requirements, then representing the program to customers with well-formed positions. You manage the program schedule, track critical path, and keep customers aligned. You're the person who knows whether the program is on track and what to do when it isn't. You're also the technical counterpart to business development — when we pursue new missions, you ensure what we sign up to is executable before we commit.

This is a full-time, exempt
position located in our Long Beach
location.

Responsibilities

Own and maintain the integrated master schedule (IMS), critical path analysis, and milestone tracking
Own system-level requirements — capture in the digital twin toolchain, flow down to subsystem teams
Own system budget closure against mission and customer requirements — engineering maintains the bottoms-up budgets (mass, power, data, link), you own whether they close with adequate margin and drive resolution when they don't
Represent the customer and mission perspective within engineering — challenge system trades and design decisions against requirements, build consensus with the engineering team, and bring well-formed positions to customer negotiations
Manage customer interface — payload requirements, ICD negotiations, and schedule alignment across all manifest slots
Manage the satellite manifest — which sat gets which payload, build order, configuration tracking
Negotiate launch contracts and manage the launch vehicle provider relationship
Plan and coordinate the launch campaign — launch site logistics, range compliance, satellite shipping and stacking sequence
Plan facility readiness — engineering offices, avionics lab, manufacturing floor, clean room, TVAC, vibe, integration bay
Track risks, action items, and review close-out across all design reviews
Manage L-minus milestone tracking (L-180 through L-14)
Coordinate spectrum licensing for confirmed and TBD customer payloads
Own status reporting — weekly cadence, management visibility
Partner with business development as the technical counterpart on proposals and new business — ensure what we sign up to is executable before we commit
Track vendor delivery schedules with the procurement lead

Within Your First 6 Weeks

Baseline the IMS and critical path with the Director of Engineering
Establish customer relationships and understand payload requirements status for all 10 manifest slots (6 confirmed, 4 TBD)
Take ownership of system budgets and identify any that aren't closed with margin
Understand the facility planning timeline and flag any gaps
Take ownership of program execution — drive schedule, customer relationships, and cross-functional coordination

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a related technical discipline
8+ years of engineering experience in aerospace or defense
3+ years of program management, mission engineering, or systems engineering leadership experience
Experience running satellite or complex hardware delivery programs — schedule, cost, customer management
Strong systems engineering background — you can own requirements, budgets, and interfaces, not just track them
Experience managing multi-unit builds (constellation, batch production, or similar)
Managed customer and launch vehicle provider relationships
Comfortable with fast-paced, lean programs — you're the kind of person who runs the schedule in a spreadsheet before the formal tools are set up
Strong written and verbal communication — you'll represent the program to customers and leadership

Preferred Skills & Experience

Able to obtain a security clearance
Launch campaign experience (any launch provider)
Payload accommodation and ICD negotiation experience across multiple customer types
Experience with launch site facility operations
Spectrum licensing and regulatory coordination

Pay Range: California

$188,600—$267,720 USD

We calibrate level and compensation to the selected candidate's experience and demonstrated capability. We welcome applicants across a range of experience levels to apply.

Compensation And Benefits

Base salary will vary depending on job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, business needs, and market demand. Salary is just one component of our comprehensive compensation package. Full-time employees also receive company equity, as well as access to a full suite of compelling benefits and perks, including: medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents, generous paid time off; up to 20+ days of vacation for exempt staff and up to 10+ days of vacation for non-exempt staff with the ability to cash-out unused vacation annually, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, ClassPass credits, personalized mental healthcare through Spring Health, and other discounts and perks. new_jobs.description:
Job Description

The VP of Money Movement Engineering will lead the strategic technical direction for our global payment infrastructure. This leader is responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle of money movement, from the implementation of domestic real-time rails (RTP, FedNow, Zelle) and legacy systems (ACH) to the integration of international standards like SEPA. You will be the primary technical authority for ensuring that our payment systems are scalable, resilient, and compliant with global industry standards (ISO 20022), while maintaining rigorous Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for millions of consumer transactions.

Key Responsibilities

Payment Rail Implementation & Integration
Domestic Rails: Lead the engineering and deployment of U.S. payment rails, including ACH, The Clearing House (TCH) RTP, FedNow, and Zelle.
European Standards: Oversee the integration and maintenance of SEPA (SCT, SCT Inst, and SDD) to ensure seamless Euro-denominated transactions across the Single Euro Payments Area.
ISO 20022 Migration: Drive the adoption of ISO 20022 messaging standards across all payment flows to ensure data richness, interoperability, and future-proofing of the payment stack.
Scalability & Performance Engineering
High-Throughput Architecture: Design and manage distributed, event-driven systems capable of processing high-volume consumer transactions at scale with sub-second latency.
SLA Management: Define, monitor, and guarantee strict Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for payment availability, processing times, and settlement finality.
Resiliency & Recovery: Implement robust disaster recovery (DR) and business continuity plans (BCP) specifically for money movement, ensuring zero data loss and high availability (99.99% or higher).
Governance, Standards & Compliance
Industry Standards: Ensure all integrations adhere to NACHA rules, Federal Reserve regulations, and European Payments Council (EPC) guidelines.
Security & Risk: Partner with Information Security and Fraud teams to integrate real-time risk scoring and AML/KYC checks into the payment orchestration layer.
Reconciliation & Ledgering: Oversee the engineering of automated, real-time reconciliation systems to ensure the integrity of the general ledger and customer accounts.
Strategic Leadership & Vendor Management
Technical Roadmap: Define the 3-year vision for the "New Payment Rails" (NPR) team, balancing the modernization of legacy systems with the adoption of emerging instant payment technologies.
Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary technical liaison for external partners, including central banks, clearing houses (TCH, EBA Clearing), and payment service providers (PSPs).
Team Mentorship: Build and lead a high-performing team of payment engineers, architects, and SREs specializing in financial transaction systems.

Required Qualifications & Skills

Technical Expertise

Engineering Leadership: 12+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 6 years in a senior leadership role specifically within Payments or Fintech.
Rail Mastery: Deep, hands-on experience with the technical specifications of ACH, RTP, FedNow, Zelle, and SEPA.
Messaging Standards: Expert knowledge of ISO 20022, SWIFT MT/MX, and JSON-based API payment protocols.
Cloud-Native Infrastructure: Proven experience building high-scale systems on AWS, GCP, or Azure using microservices, Kafka, and distributed databases (e.g., Cassandra, CockroachDB).

Strategic Leadership

Operational Excellence: Proven track record of managing mission-critical systems with strict uptime and performance requirements.
Regulatory Knowledge: Strong understanding of PSD2, Dodd-Frank, and global money transmitter licensing requirements.
Analytical Rigor: Ability to translate complex payment network rules into technical requirements and control frameworks.

Education

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

new_jobs.title: Head of Engineering, Infrastructure & SRE
new_jobs.description:
Who Are We?

Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster.

The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman.

P.S: We highly recommend reading The "API-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman.

The Opportunity

Postman is seeking a strategic and results-driven engineering leader who is passionate about cloud agnostic infrastructure, operational excellence, and enabling engineering teams to operate autonomously and build with confidence.

As Head of Infrastructure, you'll lead a talented and geographically distributed team of engineers across the SF Bay Area, India, and Europe, fostering a culture of collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement. You'll own the infrastructure that underpins one of the world's most widely used API platforms, an environment handling ~80,000 requests per second at the front door, and be responsible for its reliability, scalability, and evolution. In addition to infrastructure, you'll own the Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) function at Postman, setting the standards and practices that keep the platform reliable at scale. You'll work closely with engineering managers, product managers, and platform teams to drive the technical roadmap for our cloud agnostic infrastructure and reliability practices, ensuring we can support a large and rapidly growing engineering organization.

If you're passionate about building resilient, scalable infrastructure, have a proven track record of leading distributed engineering teams, and thrive in fast-paced environments where your decisions have company-wide impact, we want you on our team!

What You'll Do

Team Leadership & Development

Hire, manage, mentor, and coach a geographically distributed team of infrastructure and SRE engineers across SF Bay Area, India, and Europe, helping them grow both technically and professionally.
Drive and uphold a culture of respect, integrity, inclusion, ownership, and accountability within the team.
Set clear goals and provide regular feedback to ensure your team is motivated and aligned with the platform and company vision.
Build a high-performing team with the skills and practices to reliably operate and evolve cloud agnostic infrastructure at scale.
Foster psychological safety and cross-regional collaboration across time zones.

Technical Leadership

Own the architecture and evolution of Postman's cloud agnostic infrastructure, driving improvements that increase reliability, performance, and cost efficiency at scale.
Lead the design and implementation of infrastructure improvements across Kubernetes, Cluster API, Argo, Helm, Crossplane, service mesh (Istio), AWS, and Azure environments.
Own the SRE function end to end: SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, capacity planning, incident management, and reliability engineering practices across the platform.
Set the technical direction for how Postman's infrastructure and reliability practices evolve to support a large engineering organization with hundreds of services and dozens of teams, with a focus on enabling product teams to operate autonomously.
Partner with platform, security, and product engineering teams to ensure infrastructure and reliability decisions align with broader company goals.
Ensure infrastructure and reliability best practices are upheld across the organization, including GitOps, CI/CD, observability, on-call, and incident response.

Project Management

Own the infrastructure and reliability roadmap, balancing operational reliability with longer-term architectural investments.
Break down complex infrastructure and reliability initiatives into clear, actionable milestones and manage delivery on time and at high quality.
Proactively identify and resolve roadblocks, working across teams to unblock engineering work and minimize customer impact.

Collaboration & Communication

Work closely with stakeholders across engineering, product, and security teams to align on infrastructure and reliability priorities and constraints.
Foster open communication within and across teams, promoting transparency on system health, risk, error budgets, and roadmap.
Represent infrastructure and SRE in leadership forums, advocating for technical needs and communicating clearly on trade-offs.

Operational Excellence & Site Reliability Engineering

Own Postman's SRE function, establishing and evolving on-call practices, escalation policies, monitoring, and incident management across the company.
Define and track SLIs/SLOs and error budgets for critical services, using them to guide investment decisions and prioritization.
Drive a blameless postmortem culture, ensuring incidents produce durable learnings, clear action items, and measurable follow-through.
Drive a culture of continuous improvement, learning from incidents, automating toil, and reducing operational burden so that product engineering teams can ship independently.
Champion proactive reliability practices such as load testing and capacity planning to stay ahead of scale.
Maintain high standards for security, cost management, and infrastructure quality across all environments.

About You

You are a seasoned infrastructure and reliability leader with deep technical expertise and a track record of building and managing high-performing, distributed infrastructure and SRE teams. You've owned large-scale cloud agnostic environments and the reliability practices that keep them running, and know how to balance the demands of keeping the lights on with investing in architectural improvements that compound over time. You understand that great infrastructure and reliability engineering are ultimately about enabling teams to move fast independently and with confidence.

Must Have Qualifications

15+ years of experience in infrastructure, platform, or site reliability engineering, with 7+ years in an engineering management or leadership role.
Proven experience managing geographically distributed teams across multiple time zones.
Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Cluster API, Argo, Helm, and Crossplane in large-scale production environments.
Experience with service mesh technologies, including Istio.
Deep experience with both AWS and Azure cloud infrastructure.
Demonstrated experience building or leading a Site Reliability Engineering function, including on-call, incident management, SLIs/SLOs, and error budgets.
Demonstrated ability to design and implement cloud agnostic infrastructure that enables engineering teams to be autonomous and self-sufficient.
Experience supporting a large engineering organization: multiple product teams, hundreds of services, high deployment frequency, and significant traffic scale.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex infrastructure and reliability topics for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Nice-to-Have

Experience with GitOps workflows and infrastructure-as-code at scale.
Familiarity with FinOps / cloud cost optimization practices.
Prior experience in a SaaS or API-focused product company.
A passion for developer experience: building infrastructure and reliability practices that make product engineers faster and more confident.

The reasonably estimated base salary for this role ranges from $290,000 to $340,000, plus a competitive equity package. Actual compensation is based on the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience.

What Else?

In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about. We’re building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves.

At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in-person that cannot be replicated via zoom.

Our Values

At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can.

Equal opportunity

Postman is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Postman does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. Postman will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Postman.
